scope: Non-operational computational/literature analysis only. No pathogen engineering, wet-lab protocol, clinical treatment claim, or operational viral manipulation.

result.hard_boundary: A breakthrough-level claim now requires information not already encoded in the literature used to generate the claim: a genuinely new quantitative observable or prediction with independent confirmation.
result.reason: Further recombination of known capsid hysteresis, symmetry breaking, cargo-shell coupling, time-reversal asymmetry, hidden-state inference, metastability, or viral inactivation kinetics cannot honestly be promoted to a new discovery because these mechanism classes have substantial prior art.

additional_TOPA_SPIDER_kills: Biphasic aerosol-virus decay associated with droplet equilibration, efflorescence, pH and phase-state transitions is established prior art.
State-dependent reaction coordinates and hidden memory under coarse-graining are established concepts in nonequilibrium/statistical physics.
Viral metastability and the trade-off between capsid stability, entry, uncoating and fitness are established across multiple virus systems.
Single-particle HIV uncoating literature already separates rate-limiting capsid opening from later lattice collapse and shows that regulators can tune these stages differently.

required_next_evidence_class.name: ORIGINAL_INDEPENDENT_INFORMATION_GAIN
all_required: A quantitative hypothesis and scoring rule frozen before outcome inspection.
Analysis of raw public data or newly released data that yields a material observable not taken from the authors' stated conclusion.
Independent replication on a separate dataset or viral system.
Explicit null/reversible control that remains negative.
Dedicated prior-art search after the result that finds no equivalent reported result.
Replayable provenance from freeze through analysis and unblinding.

promotion_rule: NO amount of additional literature synthesis alone may set SCIENTIFIC_BREAKTHROUGH=true. The status can change only on new independent information gain satisfying C024 and this boundary.
